div.head: Af 37.2
div.ab: Gif he hwæt (to) yfele gedon hæfð þær he ær wæs, bete ðæt þonne se ðe hine to men onfó, ond cyninge CXX scll' to wite.
Gif he hwæt yfla gedon hæbbe ðær he ær wæs, bete ðæt se ðe hine ðonne to men onfo, ⁊ cyninge CXX scill. to wite.
Si quid (etiam) malefecit ubi prius fuit, hoc emendet qui eum ad hominem receperit et regi centum uiginti sol. wite.
Gif he hwæt yfla gedon hæbbe ðær he ær wæs, bete ðæt se ðe hine ðonne to men onfo, ⁊ cy___ninge CXX scill to wite.
If he has commited some offense where he was before, let him who took him on as his man compensate for that, and 120 shillings to the king as fine.
If he has committed any manner of offence in the place where he has been [residing], he who now takes him into his employment shall pay compensation for it, and a fine of 120 shillings to the king.
Wenn er etwas übles gethan hatte, da wo er früher war, so büsse dies der [Herr], welcher ihn nunmehr zum Manne annimmt [an den Geschädigten], und dem Könige 120 Schill. zur Strafe.
If he had done anything evil where he was before, let the [lord] who now takes him on as his man make amends for it [to the injured party], and [pay] the king 120 shillings as a fine.
